description:
Site: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs:225

Comment reads: 'For very large accounts (IMAP migration), push filter/sort into the backend query.'

Current implementation loads all mailbox objects and filter/sorts in memory — acceptable for typical account sizes but O(n) for IMAP-migration accounts.

Refactor needs:
1. Extend MailBackend::query_objects to accept filter and sort args (currently None, None).
2. Update MemoryBackend test fixture to honour those args.
3. Document the contract for production backends.

Likely best done after JMAP-hwdv (MemoryBackend extraction) lands, but not strictly blocked on it.
title: Push Mailbox filter/sort into MailBackend query for large-account scale
